topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can't stop thinking about it. All these years, I had no clue. He's been pouring all this stuff about us into a book, and I don't know whether to feel honored or completely exposed. Was it a way to capture us, the good and the bad, or just to spill out everything he couldn't say? I want to read it, to understand, but at the same time, the thought of seeing myself through his eyes, laid bare on paper, makes my heart race. Part of me whispers that it's intimate, another part screams invasion. I don't know what to do, but I know we need to talk. I need to know why.
